tools.name: kourses_list_memberships
tools.description: List the published memberships of the Kourses website this key belongs to. Each has an id, name, slug and URL. Kourses API: GET /memberships.

tools.name: kourses_list_member_memberships
tools.description: List the memberships a member can access now (permissions that have not expired). Give the member by id or email. Kourses API: GET /members/{member}/memberships.

tools.name: kourses_create_member
tools.description: Create a member on the Kourses website. If a member with this email already exists, the given fields OVERWRITE the stored ones and the status is 'updated'. Sends an activation email only when send_activation_notification is true (default false here; the API default is true). Kourses API: POST /membe

tools.name: kourses_grant_membership_access
tools.description: Give a member access to a membership, optionally until a date. No email is sent unless send_notification is true. Repeating a call keeps one permission, but sends the email again when send_notification is true. Kourses API: POST /members/{member}/memberships/{membership}/permissions.

tools.name: kourses_revoke_membership_access
tools.description: Remove a member's access to a membership now, or on ends_at when it is given. The member loses the content they paid for; confirm first. Kourses API: DELETE /members/{member}/memberships/{membership}/permissions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kourses_list_memberships, kourses_list_member_memberships · Public sink: kourses_list_member_memberships, kourses_create_member, kourses_grant_membership_access · Destructive: kourses_create_member, kourses_revoke_membership_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kourses_list_memberships, kourses_list_member_memberships · Public sink: kourses_list_member_memberships, kourses_create_member, kourses_grant_membership_access · Destructive: kourses_create_member, kourses_revoke_membership_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
